title: census + decision shape: AGENTS.md commandment #-1 (English-only) has NO mechanical reader in this repo, and 205 non-test source files carry Han
body:
Dedupe words: `english-only commandment` · `Chinese source comments` · `non-ASCII source sweep` · `commandment #-1 gate` · `i18n literal census`

Surfaced by the objectui#10043 dev while repairing one shipped Chinese `title` attribute, as the ANSWER to the question triage attached to that card: 「⚠️ 这条命令这么绝对,却没有机械读者,就一定会再犯」. ⭐ **Re-measured first-hand by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat before filing** (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) — 说明 GG. ⛔ No `priority:*` and no `type` are written here: both are the triage seat's sole production. `domain:ui` is inherited from the in-flight parent objectui#10043 under the derivation exception.

## Finding 1 — ⭐ NO gate in this repository enforces commandment #-1

Established by the #10043 dev by elimination, against a probe shown to work. ⛔ **Recorded as 转述, ⛔ not re-run by this seat** — the taking dev re-takes it rather than trusting this table:

| candidate | why it is silent |
|---|---|
| ESLint | the repo's own `eslint-rules` holds 11 rules, none about language or script |
| workflows | none scans for non-English text |
| `check:control-bytes` | scoped by its own file header to **control characters**, ⛔ not to letters outside ASCII — it was green on the #10043 defect **by design** |
| `check:i18n-keys` | reports a `t()` key no pack defines ⇒ a hardcoded literal that calls no `t()` is **invisible** to it, and it too was green on that exact line |

What does exist is narrow and per-component: a few no-provider-fallback-must-not-be-CJK assertions in `packages/fields` and `packages/app-shell`, plus locale-pack assertions in `packages/i18n` that values ARE in the pack's script. ⛔ None generalises past its own component. ⭐ The probe used finds all of those sites, so the absence of a repo-wide reader is a reading, ⛔ not a failed search.

## Finding 2 — the scale, measured by this seat, and it is an UPPER BOUND

Counting rule, stated so it can be argued with: every tracked `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.js` / `.jsx` / `.mjs` file under `packages/` or `apps/`, **minus `packages/i18n/src/locales/`**, that contains any code point in `U+4E00..U+9FFF`. Read on `origin/main`:

```
source files scanned (minus locale catalogues): 4741
files carrying Han: 865  | non-test: 205
```

⭐ **Two controls, same act, both directions**: the instrument finds Han in `packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` (a file provably full of it, and deliberately outside the population), and finds **none** in `en.ts` (the must-be-zero control). ⇒ the 865 is a reading and the 3,876 quiet files are not a dark pass.

⚠️ **865 is ⛔ NOT a defect count, and nothing here claims it is.** The heaviest non-test carriers on that reading are exactly why:

| Han code points | file | what it plainly is |
|--:|---|---|
| 14,257 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` | a translation table — ⛔ legitimate |
| 1,571 | `packages/plugin-gantt/demo/main.tsx` | a demo |
| 234 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts` | another translation table |
| 205 | `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` | ⭐ a real candidate |
| 153 | `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` | ⭐ a real candidate |

⇒ the population certainly contains translation tables the filter did not exclude and tests that assert Chinese rendering on purpose. **Triaging it is the work**, and the number's only job is to say how big the job is.

⚠️ The #10043 dev's own figures were **847 / 187** on a slightly different extension set and test filter. ⛔ Neither reading is wrong — the counting rules differ, which is precisely why this card states its rule in full rather than quoting a number.

## ⚠️ One instrument hazard, measured, that will bite whoever takes this

The #10043 dev's FIRST probe was `grep -P` with the Han property class. It returned **0 on the subject AND 0 on a file provably full of Han** — this container's `grep` does not honour that class. ⛔ Reporting 「absent」 from it would have been a false zero of exactly the kind this board keeps paying for. ⇒ ⭐ whatever probe the taking dev uses, it must be shown finding Han somewhere before any zero it reports means anything.

## What this card is NOT, and the decision inside it

⛔ It does ⛔ not propose building a gate. **Adding a required gate is a maintainer-floor decision** (门禁强度), and the #10043 dev was explicitly told to answer the question and ⛔ not act on it. So the first deliverable here is the SHAPE of the ask, not a `.mjs` file:

1. **Triage the 205 non-test carriers** into: legitimate (translation tables, tests asserting Chinese rendering, fixtures) vs. real violations. ⭐ Until that split exists, nobody can say what a gate would have to allowlist, and a gate whose allowlist is guessed is a gate that gets disabled.
2. **Then**, and only then, raise the gate question as its own decision with the triaged numbers attached — ⛔ not inside this card, and ⛔ not as a rider on any repair.

⚠️ Repairs found along the way are ⛔ not this card's licence to widen: file or fix them as their own items. This card's product is the census and the shape of the decision.

## Acceptance

- The 205 non-test carriers are split into legitimate vs. violating, with the criterion written down.
- Every count is re-measured at the moment it is taken, with a probe shown to find Han and a must-be-zero control lit in the same act. ⛔ The figures above are anchored to `origin/main` at filing time and are ⛔ not to be re-used.
- The gate question is raised as its own decision card carrying the triaged numbers — ⛔ no gate is added here.
